h1.en: Jackscrew illustrates the note on Diesel 40 Concrete Pump

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。理论输送量是26 m³/h，最大出口压力是25 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew. The image subject is Jackscrew. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel 40 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. The frame “Loader (equipment)” shows Front end loader 2 and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 25 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew。画面内容是Jackscrew。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油40型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 4200 × 1600 × 1800 mm. Subject: Front end loader 2. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是26 m³/h，最大出口压力是25 MPa。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 2800 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Theoretical Output. Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 112.
body.zh: 画面「Loader (equipment)」的主体是Front end 装载机 2，不是这个型号的工地实测。

body.en: Theoretical Output is 26 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 25 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 26 m³/h. Main-unit weight is 2800 kg.

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 26 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jackscrew.
